The falloff curve bins by distance to the nearest endothelial cell (validation.vessel_profile.direct_vessel_distance_um), the perivascular reference is the first bin of that curve, and the delivery spread is a percentile ratio over the resulting field - so all three measure the 12-pseudo-cells-per-spot synthesis, not this tissue's vascular architecture. Read NOTHING on this section as a statement about where its vessels are. section_caveats.reason: Per-cell spatial statistics are INVALID on this section. A Visium spot pools several cells over ~55 um and this pipeline does not measure where they sit - it synthesises 12 pseudo-cells per spot at the spot centroid with uniform jitter. The per-cell attenuation spread and the immune-neighbourhood structure ratio would measure that jitter, not the tissue (results/immune_sink_impact.md §5.6). THE DELIVERY MAP IS INVALID HERE TOO, AND FOR THE SAME REASON. The exposure field is solved on the grid, but its SOURCE is a density over ENDOTHELIAL CELL POSITIONS, and on a spot section those positions are synthesised exactly like every other cell's. The falloff curve bins by distance to the nearest endothelial cell (validation.vessel_profile.direct_vessel_distance_um), the perivascular reference is the first bin of that curve, and the delivery spread is a percentile ratio over the resulting field - so all three measure the 12-pseudo-cells-per-spot synthesis, not this tissue's vascular architecture. Read NOTHING on this section as a statement about where its vessels are. (An earlier version of this sentence, written on 2026-08-21, claimed the exposure map and its falloff DID survive this refusal because they are solved on the grid. That was wrong: it confused where the PDE is discretised with where its source term comes from. The same sentence previously named the cross-drug RANKING as what survived, which was withdrawn the same day - results/pk_ranking_robustness.md, results/capacity_ranking_robustness.md.)

oxygen_block.source: physics.solve_oxygen driven by the real vascular field
oxygen_block.caveat: WEAK BUT BEST-IN-CLASS (results/state_validation.md §1.2, results/oxygen_demotion.md): against measured hypoxia markers on 816,769 cells the solve scores rho -0.1523, out-predicting a distance transform on its own source cells (-0.1204) and its own undiffused source term (-0.1111). The default is 'pde' ON that evidence, not despite it. Read the magnitude, though: |rho| ~ 0.15 is a weak, within-section association carried by VEGFA alone (HIF1A contributes +0.0140), so this is the best of several weak predictors and not a validated oxygen field. SEPARATELY AND STILL TRUE: OxygenConfig.consumption is unfitted, so the solve's effective diffusion length is several times the published ~150 um -- a Spearman rho cannot detect that, because it is invariant to monotone rescaling. Absolute levels and band edges remain uncalibrated. An earlier version of this caveat declared the solve FALSIFIED AS VALUE-ADD; that claim was an inverted inequality and has been withdrawn.

Retained as the default so no published number moves silently, NOT because it is the best available route.

RESOLUTION: this run used dx = 30 um. THERE IS NO dx AT WHICH THIS PIPELINE HAS BEEN SHOWN TO BE GRID-CONVERGED, and an earlier version of this caveat said otherwise: it asserted that kill_fraction is grid-converged for dx <= 20 um and that the penetration index is over-estimated on coarse grids. BOTH HALVES ARE WITHDRAWN. (a) The kill plateau was measured on ONE Xenium GBM section for ONE metric and does not transfer -- on breast, docetaxel's verdict FLIPS FAIL -> PASS between dx = 12 and dx = 16 um, and on the GBM panel the scored ratio is NON-MONOTONE in dx for all three drugs tested, which is not an asymptotic regime. (b) The penetration ladder RISES with refinement -- 0.1110 at dx = 60 um to 0.3062 at dx = 10 um -- so a coarse mesh UNDER-states the index, the opposite direction to what was printed here. What survives, and is why this is a warning rather than a footnote: dx is the LARGEST single driver of the penetration index measured on that section (|elasticity| 0.747, 3.1x the next knob), and it reaches the answer through the RECONSTRUCTION -- the oxygen solve, the cell-state banding and the IFP/velocity solve all live on the grid -- so a converged transport step does not imply a converged prediction. Read every number from this run as carrying an unquantified mesh term. This is NOT a claim that the solver is broken: mass is conserved to ~4e-14 on the real irregular mask and the prediction is dt-converged to <1e-2 for dt <~ 20 s, and neither of those is affected by any of the above. (results/numerical_rigor.md CORRECTION + section 2; results/grid_convergence_breast.md; results/grid_convergence_gbm.md) This run is COARSER STILL: at dx = 30 um it sits on the part of both ladders where the coarse rungs (24 and 30 um) understate the scored ratio by the largest margin measured -- up to 11.7% in a single refinement step.
Systemic PK is the documented Stage-0 simplification: a single time-averaged sustained plasma level drives the transport solve (tmesim/sim/engine.py), not a time-resolved infusion.
